description.p: Laby Launcher delivers LabyMod, the ultimate free all-in-one client for Minecraft: Java Edition, bundling 300+ mods, 3D voice chat, cosmetics and a modern launcher into a single download for Windows, macOS and Linux. Beyond LabyMod, the launcher also lets you create and run instances for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge and Quilt, so everything you play lives in one place.

ul.li: Incredible performance - Freezes, lags and poor FPS are a thing of the past. With doubled performance your game feels smoother than ever before.
Your game, your style - Switch at any time between a stunning, high-resolution modern theme and the classic, iconic Minecraft look.
Built-in VoiceChat - Free in-game voice chat with 3D surround sound and proximity audio on every multiplayer server - no plugins, no setup required.
Cosmetics with character - Handcrafted, passionately animated and highly customizable cosmetics, plus a skin and cape library with 3D preview and support for your own uploads.
Reinvented screenshots - Capture and share 3D screenshots with automatic player tagging.
Stay connected - A server-independent friends chat with tabs and a freely movable chat window keeps you in touch wherever you play.
One launcher for everything - Create instances for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge and Quilt, each with its own mods and configuration, and import existing setups from launchers like MultiMC or Prism.

description.p: Note: LabyMod is not an official Minecraft product. It is not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

description.p: We've rebranded from "LabyMod Launcher" to Laby Launcher. The new name reflects what the launcher has become: it's no longer just for LabyMod.

You can now create instances for Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, Quilt and more, each with its own version, mods and configuration. And if you're coming from another launcher, you can import your existing setups from other launchers (e.g. MultiMC/Prism), with automatic detection doing most of the work for you.

The entire launcher has been redesigned around our new design language we recently used in our website relaunch. The overview, settings, news and logs have all been rebuilt to be cleaner and easier to navigate.

Alongside the visual rework, we added management features for mods, addons, resource packs, shaders, screenshots and servers directly in our launcher. The skin & cape library now loads faster, supports uploading your own skins, and includes a 3D cape preview.

Performance was a major focus this release. Startup no longer blocks on bad network or outages - alongside faster downloads for game files. On top of all the new work, we've cleaned up a huge backlog of long-standing bugs and broken behavior that had piled up over the years.
